params.name: country
params.description: The 2-letter ISO 3166-1 code of the country to get headlines for.

params.name: category
params.description: The category to get headlines for.

params.name: sources
params.description: Comma-separated string of identifiers for news sources or blogs.

params.name: q
params.description: Keywords or phrases to search for in article title and body.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of results to return per page (max 100).

params.name: page
params.description: Use this to page through the results.

items.docs: Provides live top and breaking headlines for a country, specific category in a country, single source, or multiple sources.
